Name: Express Mail
Author: DaTravBoo
Description:
Express Mail

Tired of having to close your mailbox, and click it open again every single time you have more than one letter waiting for you? [b]Express Mail[/b] adds a seamless quality of life fix to Stardew Valley's letter reading experience.

✨ Features
[list]
[*][b]Seamless Mail Queueing:[/b] When you reach the final page of a letter and have more mail waiting, the forward arrow stays right where it is.
[/*]
[*][b]One-Click Transitions:[/b] Click the arrow to instantly jump straight into your next piece of mail—no closing menus or re-opening the mailbox required.
[/*]
[*][b]Full Compatibility:[/b] Works with both single-page and multi-page letters, pulling native text data cleanly and matching vanilla UI styling perfectly.
[/*]
[/list]📦 Installation
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[/*]
[*]Unzip the
[code]ExpressMail[/code]folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley\Mods[/code]directory.
[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI![/*]
[/list]
